stem.text: A projectile of mass $0.25\,\text{kg}$ is at a height of $30\,\text{m}$ above horizontal ground and travelling at a speed of $15\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. A short time later, it is at a height of $35\,\text{m}$ above the horizontal ground and travelling at a speed of $5.0\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
How much work is done against air resistance during this time?
